As someone who’s adopted, I have so many feelings on this subject. I wasn’t a planned pregnancy. My birth mom and dad were in high school! They weren’t trying, they weren’t happy… they were scared and trying to do their best. I’m grateful my birth mom was brave and placed me for adoption. I was placed into a family who desperately wanted children. My mom tried for 8 heart wrenching years to have kids. Despite me being an unwanted pregnancy, I was the most wanted and loved baby by my adoptive parents. A lot of love and thought went into me on both sides. Babies don’t ask to be here but we owe them the chance at life if we’re going to play around with being sexually active. Now, I feel strongly that those who have their agency taken away from them and are SA’ed shouldn’t have to carry the baby. And If the mother’s life is in danger, this is also a case I understand when it comes to abortion. But it’s so hard to make abortion only allowed for those situations vs the others because people can lie. Or the people who truly need it won’t be able to get it. It’s a subject that truly frustrates me because I don’t know the answer as far as laws go. But I do know that I stand with Life. It’s such a complicated subject.
